issue.title: Bug: `test_voq_chassis_app_db_consistency.py` fails trying to get_db_dump on rebooting dT2

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

In `test_voq_chassis_app_db_consistency.py` dut_reboot case, in the dT2 case `get_db_dump` called on the DUT rebooting, after the reboot has started and SSH has gone down. This will fail as the DUT is rebooting.

This is not a problem in T2 as the DUT rebooting will always be a frontend node, and `get_db_dump` is always called on the supervisor.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run `test_voq_chassis_app_db_consistency.py` on dT2 device.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Test will fail when trying to executie `get_db_dump` with `Timeout (62s) waiting for privilege escalation prompt: `. (Unless platform specific reboot failed, which will cause the db to go down slightly later where the test may be able to execute, this is not normal behaviour).

It should not test during reboot for dT2 (or where there is only one duthost)

resolution.title: Ensure get_db_dump is not called on rebooting DUT
resolution.description:

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
`test_voq_chassis_app_db_consisitency.py` reboot_dut case on dT2 would fail with `Timeout (62s) waiting for privilege escalation prompt:` as it would try to perform `get_db_dump` on the rebooting dut. Not a problem for T2 as the DUT rebooting is always a frontend node and `get_db_dump` is always called on a supervisor node.
#### How did you do it?
Made a change so test would only `check_db_consistency` on a rebooting DUT if there are more than 1 DUT (basically if it's T2)
#### How did you verify/test it?
Ran the test, didn't see the same failure.
